Story and voice

Who CMO.XYZ is and how it sounds.

LockedLogo →

What CMO.XYZ is

An AI agent that runs a business's marketing from one place.

Social, content, Google and Meta ads, SEO and graphics. You give it your domain. It builds the strategy and gets to work. It's made for solo founders, builders and small businesses with no marketing team.

Playful

Cuso is a cursor with rubber legs, so a light joke fits. Make it once and move on.

Smart

Every claim points to real data or something the customer already told us.

Friendly

Sound like a sharp teammate. Short sentences, plain words, no stiff corporate talk.

How Cuso sounds

"On it. I'll draft that now and put anything that needs approval in your Approvals. You'll get a note when it's ready."

Writing rules

  • If information is missing, ask for it directly.
  • State the conclusion the data supports.
  • Keep hyphens and em dashes out of product copy.
  • Write the product name as CMO.XYZ, in capitals.

Clear space and size

How much room the logo gets, and how small it can go.

ProposedColour →

Clear space

Keep 1x clear on every side. x is the cap height of the C in the lockup's wordmark. Text, other logos and the edge of the layout stay outside it.

Minimum width

AssetScreenPrint
Lockups with the mascot120 px30 mm
Wordmark80 px20 mm
Monogram24 px8 mm

Colour

White leads. Iris gets the attention.

ApprovedType →

Balance

60%
30%
10%

Black carries the type and the outlines. Iris is the small loud part, so use it where you want people to look.

White#FFFFFF
Black#000000
Iris#FF51FF

Text on Iris

Always black (7.9:1 contrast). White on Iris is only 2.7:1, so keep it off text.
